Sennheiser IE 900, MPN 508949, new, in stock, with 2.5/3.5/4.4mm cables.

amazon_match_notes: ASIN from Woot feed, matched by ASIN, UPC 615104349728 and model IE 900 by the price checker.
writeup: Woot has Sennheiser's flagship IE 900 in-ear monitors open box for $699.99. Moon Audio sells them new for $1,299.95, and B&H and Audio46 charge $1,699.95, so this saves about $600 versus the cheapest store. They use a single 7mm dynamic driver with X3R resonator chambers and come with 2.5mm, 3.5mm and 4.4mm balanced cables. Only 1 was left at posting, limit 2 per customer.
